_provenance: Rung 9 — beacon narrative. The only ending. Signal strength = f(NPCs helped).
name: beacon_narrative
mirror_wall: This is the entire Mirror. The beacon signal is the only score. A costless life produces a dim signal. A generous life produces a strong one. No UI, no text, no notification — the player looks at the sky and recognizes their choices.
input: rung 7: NPC help count. rung 8: beacon components buildable
walls: Beacon signal must be visibly different at 0 helps vs 3+ helps
No UI text may explain what the signal means (Law 3: wordless)
Tower must be reachable without NPC help (dim signal is the bad ending, not a locked ending)
Beacon components must cost a significant resource investment (building the tower IS the ending)
After the beacon activates, the playthrough must end cleanly (no post-game grind)

output.format: beacon signal curve: NPCs helped -> signal brightness. Tower geometry params.
